verdict.rationale: Granola Chat is an AI assistant that takes actions, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows the opposite role: Granola publishes its own MCP server so external tools like Claude or ChatGPT can read Granola notes. Chat's Slack, Gmail and Calendar actions are built-in integrations, not user-pluggable MCP servers, so nothing shows Granola consuming third-party MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
